_comment: Sites (locations with their own internet line) and departments. The server reads this file from STOWLINE_SITES_FILE; package-installer.py --sites ships the same file to the setup wizard. Site ids are lowercase and permanent. Times are local to the site's timezone. measured_upload_mbps / budget_percent are optional starting values (also editable in Settings); a site with no measurement admits no backups until one is entered.
